caption: Strength training for busy women starts with one reframe: stop training to get smaller, start training to carry your actual week. Five patterns, push, pull, squat, hinge, core. Save this if it lands.

voiceover.text: Fitness keeps telling you to get smaller. Your life disagrees.
Your week never asks you to shrink. It asks you to carry, lift, climb and hold.
Push strength opens heavy doors and gets you up off the floor.
Pull strength hauls the suitcase off the carousel and the shopping up the stairs.
Squat strength is every staircase with something in your arms.
Hinge strength picks things up off the floor without a second thought.
Core strength holds it all steady, including the child on your hip.
Train to carry, and the week gets lighter. What did you carry today? Tell me in the comments.
